0e34477748.q: How does MB Mentors financially sustain its free mentoring services without employee payroll?
0e34477748.a: MB Mentors generates revenue exclusively through paid CEO roundtables for second-stage businesses with revenues between $1 million and $50 million. With 8 to 12 CEOs meeting monthly for 10 months per year, this revenue stream covers organizational costs while all other services—mentoring, webinars, business plan support, women's collective lab, and website resources—remain completely free. Since all 41 volunteer mentors work without compensation, the organization avoids payroll and benefits costs.

6f8d1d5d03.q: What was MB Mentors' business model pivot when the COVID-19 pandemic hit on March 11th, 2020?
6f8d1d5d03.a: MB Mentors launched on March 6th, 2020, intending to conduct in-person mentoring, workshops, and CEO roundtables, but five days later the pandemic forced an immediate pivot to a virtual organization. The organization quickly adopted Zoom and has since found virtual delivery beneficial for accessibility, though roundtable participants have expressed strong preference for in-person dynamics when possible.

db4e3b5796.q: What is the primary objection early-stage business owners face when engaging with MB Mentors mentorship?
db4e3b5796.a: Early-stage business owners typically discover that starting and running a business costs more money, takes more time, and creates more frustration than expected. The core issue is often not a specific skill gap in marketing, sales, or operations, but rather prioritization—they have so many competing priorities that they cannot execute effectively without help identifying which tasks are urgent and important versus nice to do.
